description: Deterministic all-optical switching in [Pt/Co]N multilayers assembled from components each insufficient alone. The composed option (field-free, helicity-independent reversal in nine-bilayer stacks) did not exist in the environment before 2026; every component was known, and the composition was not.

components.name: pulse fluence above the AOS threshold
components.law: heat capacity and the Curie point; heating toward Tc is a hard law

components.name: lateral confinement of the excitation to wavelength scale (spot below ~1.36 um at N=3)
components.law: vectorial diffraction (Richards-Wolf); spot diameter set by NA and beam topology

components.name: dipolar stabilization from the surrounding unheated film (Bz ~ mu0*Ms/2)
components.law: magnetostatics; scales with magnetic thickness N

components.name: pulse accumulation (~200+ pulses per illuminated area at 1 kHz)
components.law: thermal cycling and cumulative domain growth; ferromagnet lacks single-pulse sublattice dynamics

components.name: suppressed longitudinal field at focus (Ez(0)=0 by azimuthal symmetry)
components.law: electromagnetic symmetry under tight focusing; holds at any NA for azimuthally symmetric beams

components.name: MCD helicity bias
components.law: magnetic circular dichroism; does not hold under load - overwhelmed by thermal gradients at confined spots

rejected.ruled_out_by: confinement: same fluence, larger spot - permanent sample damage for N=3-5 and nondeterministic multidomain formation for N=6-9 (supplement section 11)
sublattice dynamics: a purely ferromagnetic stack lacks the ferrimagnetic two-sublattice mechanism; single pulses demagnetize and nucleate without deterministic reversal

budget_terms: pulse count per illuminated area (time budget at fixed repetition rate)
fluence window between AOS threshold and damage threshold

diagnostic.note: the control experiment discriminates: same fluence through a Gaussian beam damages the film; through the vector beam it switches deterministically. The binding constraint was confinement, not energy

source_class: collected - published experiment (Khalid et al., Nat Commun 17, 10843 (2026), supplementary sections 10-11)
open: stripe-domain formation at N>=10 precludes uniform reversal - a magnetostatic law, not a composition failure; no beam geometry composes around it
minimum pulse count for deterministic reversal not measured; the time budget term is unquantified (see uninstrumented case 024)
whether near-field or photonic confinement can substitute for far-field NA in the confinement term
whether the dipolar term survives bit isolation: stabilization is borrowed from the surrounding film, so an isolated bit loses part of the composition
